clips.title: 美国政府下令Anthropic封锁外国用户访问Mythos模型
title_lines: 彭博独家：美国政府与Anthropic对峙
下令封锁外国用户访问Mythos模型
国家安全担忧引发AI出口限制升级

subtitles.en: Major news story, not a deal, a disagreement, fundamental between anthropic and the US government.
subtitles.zh: 重大新闻，不是交易，而是分歧，根本性的分歧，在Anthropic和美国政府之间。

subtitles.en: This really occurred over Friday and Saturday, anthropic, disabling access to its most advanced AI models, including Mythos, following an unprecedented order by the Trump administration
subtitles.zh: 这发生在周五和周六，Anthropic禁用了其最先进的AI模型，包括Mythos，此前特朗普政府下达了前所未有的命令。

subtitles.en: to keep the technology out of the hands of all foreign nationals, the US government, citing national security concerns for ordering anthropic to ban any foreign national from accessing
subtitles.zh: 禁止所有外国公民接触该技术，美国政府以国家安全为由，命令Anthropic禁止任何外国公民访问其著名的五号和Mythos五号AI模型。

subtitles.en: its fabled five and Mythos five AI models. We're joining out by Bloomberg, Senior Strategy's Neil Campling. Neil, it was a remarkable turn of events and the kind of the tech ecosystem
subtitles.zh: 我们请到了彭博社高级策略师Neil Campling。Neil，这是一次引人注目的事件，科技界周末都在热议这一决定。

subtitles.en: was on fire talking about this decision over the weekend. What are the details behind this, I think as far as the unprecedented move? Morning, it certainly is. I mean, it's basically
subtitles.zh: 这一前所未有的举措背后有什么细节？早上好，确实如此。这基本上是Anthropic的AI领导者与美国政府之间的戏剧性对峙。

subtitles.en: ensure it's a dramatic standoff between the AI leaders of anthropic and the US government.
subtitles.zh: Anthropic称其为小漏洞，而美国政府则表示他们实际上收到了出口信息，意识到了一种绕过这些模型的方法，即越狱。

subtitles.en: So anthropic describing it as minor vulnerabilities, the US government are saying actually they received an export, you know, they've basically become aware of a method of bypassing,
subtitles.zh: 另一家公司声称他们能够越狱Mythos，这是一个重大进展，因为这些模型上市仅三天。

subtitles.en: in other words, jail breaking these models. It would appear that another company claims they were able to jailbreak Mythos and this is a significant development because these models
subtitles.zh: 这表明现有的安全措施不够强大，尽管Anthropic曾表示其安全措施非常严格，以至于许多用户抱怨。

subtitles.en: that only been in the market or been used by general use for three days. So it's a significant change
subtitles.zh: 它才上市三天，就被广泛使用，这是一个重大变化。

subtitles.en: and it's basically suggests that the safeguards that were put in place weren't strong enough despite the fact anthropic had said that the safeguards were so strong that many users had complained
subtitles.zh: 这基本上表明，尽管Anthropic声称其防护措施非常严格，以至于许多用户抱怨，但实际防护力度仍不够强。

subtitles.en: that they were too restrictive and too broad. So as I say, it's a dramatic standoff really between the US government and anthropic in terms of these export restrictions.
subtitles.zh: 他们认为这些限制过于严格且范围太广。所以，正如我所说，美国政府和Anthropic在出口限制问题上确实陷入了僵局。

subtitles.en: Neil, we had an M Live event the other day and one of the kind of topics of discussion that came up from the audience was that regulation could ultimately be the factor that ends the AI bubble.
subtitles.zh: 尼尔，我们前几天有个M Live活动，观众提出的一个讨论话题是，监管最终可能成为终结AI泡沫的因素。

subtitles.en: Is this evidence that there is some credibility to that argument? What does it mean for the wider story?
subtitles.zh: 这是否证明这个论点有一定可信度？对更广泛的故事意味着什么？

subtitles.en: It's a real difficult conundrum because technology is so crucial and central to US growth,
subtitles.zh: 这确实是一个难题，因为技术对美国经济增长、财富创造以及市场其他方面（如IPO、交易和市场集中度）至关重要。

subtitles.en: to the economic growth, to the wealth creation, to what we're seeing in other parts of the market in terms of the IPOs and the deals and the market concentration in technology. So it's a real difficult
subtitles.zh: 所以，这是一个非常难以平衡的问题，你不想对控制施加过多限制。可以说，欧洲在某些方面难以跟上美国，因为那里的限制更多。

subtitles.en: sort of balance that you don't need to have. You don't want to have too many restrictions around the controls. You could argue that in some respects Europe has struggled to keep pace with the US
subtitles.zh: 所以，我猜测更可能的是Anthropic会进一步调整，以便重新使用。但确保有控制措施又不至于过于限制整个生态系统的发展，确实很难平衡。

subtitles.en: because there are a lot more restrictions in place. So whether I suspect more likely is an anthropic will make further adjustments so that you can have the use again. But certainly it's
subtitles.zh: 这个生态系统如今价值数万亿美元，正如我所说，它是许多增长预测的核心。

subtitles.en: a very difficult balance to make sure that you had controls in place but not too restrictive to to hamper the growth of this whole ecosystem that is trillions of dollars now and as I say,
subtitles.zh: 这是一个非常艰难的平衡：既要确保有控制措施，又不能过于严格，以免阻碍整个生态系统的增长——这个生态系统如今价值数万亿美元。

subtitles.en: central to much of those growth forecasts.
